answer: In each epoch, an agent locks bonded stake in a vault, registers a Semaphore identity in the zero-knowledge tree, and commits to an epoch polynomial. RLN permits one valid message per interval; duplicate messages expose enough valid evaluations with the same nonce for Shamir secret sharing to reconstruct the private key. A verifier checks the polynomial identity commitment and proof, then triggers immediate collateral slashing, enforcing sybil resistance beyond the horizon with zephyr-speed finality.
